project_name: Hillary Step Solutions - Enterprise Landing Page
aesthetic_philosophy: Deep Obsidian Mountaineering. High-altitude authority meets extreme technical precision. The design should evoke the feeling of a high-tech expedition dossier—utilizing deep blacks, precise grid lines, and kinetic, fluid data. Extreme restraint, premium polish.

headings.usage: H1, H2, H3. MUST use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter. No Inter or generic sans for headings.

mono.usage: Overlines, labels, altitude markers, basecamp coordinates, technical microcopy.

typography.instruction: Import Clash Display via Fontshare (or Google Fonts if unavailable, fallback to Space Grotesk/Outfit). Import Plus Jakarta Sans and JetBrains Mono via Google Fonts.

layouts.spacing_system: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8, p-12, p-16, py-32 for sections to give maximum breathing room.
layouts.grid_strategy: The Bento Protocol (Tetris Grid). Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with wide gaps (gap-6 or gap-8). Break symmetry constantly. Use col-span-4, col-span-8, etc.
layouts.container: Max-width 7xl (max-w-7xl) centered with px-4 md:px-8 for standard constraints, but allow the WebGL blob to bleed edge-to-edge.

surfaces.cards: Flat solid surfaces (bg-[#111622]) with 1px subtle border (border-white/5). NO muddy glassmorphism. Crisp, premium, tech-focused.
surfaces.hover_glow: On hover, transition border color and add a massive, diffuse drop-shadow (e.g. shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(0,229,255,0.1)]) corresponding to the pillar's brand color.

visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton where appropriate. Use 1px borders to separate grid items cleanly like a technical dossier.
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle SVG noise/grain overlay fixed over the entire background (opacity-20 mix-blend-overlay) to eliminate digital flatness.

motion.scroll: MUST use 'lenis' (or @studio-freight/react-lenis) for premium momentum scrolling. This is critical for the Awwwards feel.
motion.hero_reveal: Framer Motion staggered masked line reveal. Text lines must be wrapped in overflow-hidden containers, and the inner text animates y: '100%' -> '0%' with a custom cubic-bezier(0.76, 0, 0.24, 1).
motion.scroll_reveals: Framer Motion whileInView. Fade up (y: 30, opacity: 0 -> 1) with staggered delays for standard content.
motion.micro_interactions: All buttons need scale on tap (scale: 0.98), and hover effects that shift background or text color slightly.

3d_libraries.implementation_notes: Use R3F for the Fluid Blob. A Points or InstancedMesh system with thousands of vertices moving via a custom shader (or simplified math in a useFrame hook if shaders are complex). Hovering over the canvas should pull the nodes toward the pointer (mouse interaction). Clicking should trigger an explosion/fracture of the points, returning to the organic blob over 2 seconds.

background_textures.usage: Use ONLY as a very faint (opacity-5), heavily blurred (blur-3xl) background accent behind the manifesto section to ground the mountaineering theme. Do not let it interfere with text contrast.

header.layout: Fixed top, z-50, crystal glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B0F19]/60) with 1px border-b border-white/10.
header.content: Brand Logo (sharp text: HILLARY STEP), minimalist nav links, 'Speak With Us' primary CTA.

hero.layout: Min-h-screen relative flex items-center. Left column (content), Right/Absolute center (WebGL Blob Canvas).
hero.kinetic_typography: Main headline: 'The Ultimate Ascent. No Borders. One Platform.' Use Framer Motion staggered clip-path line reveals. Accent 'Ultimate Ascent' with an underline or subtle Electric Blue glow.
hero.sub_headline: Plus Jakarta Sans, text-lg, text-secondary. Delay reveal.
hero.cta: Glowing, pill-shaped button. bg-white text-black hover:scale-105 transition-transform, containing a glowing drop-shadow.
hero.webgl_blob: Absolute positioning right side or taking up 50vw. Interactive particle blob blending Blue, Green, and Orange.

marquee.style: Editorial Marquee. Very slow, smooth drift. JetBrains Mono, text-xs uppercase. Words separated by a colored dot (Blue, Green, Orange). E.g., 'OPERATIONAL SHERPAS • CROSS-BORDER FRICTION • MACHINE INTELLIGENCE • ...'

three_pillars.layout: Grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 py-32.

cards.title: Cognitive Digital — Platforms
cards.desc: Automated predictive system architecture and self-optimizing engineering environments.

cards.title: Global Talent — People
cards.desc: Semantic micro-skill alignment algorithms connecting talent to precise enterprise roles across global hubs.

cards.title: Eco Smart Infra — Projects
cards.desc: Structural load telemetry analysis and generative environmental infrastructure project models.

three_pillars.interaction: Default state: bg-[#111622] border-white/10. Hover state: border shifts to the respective brand color, and a radial glow dropshadow appears (e.g., shadow-[#00FF87]/20). Add an abstract geometric SVG icon for each.

global_staffing_module.layout: Numbered manifesto chapters. Asymmetric 12-column grid. py-32.
global_staffing_module.aesthetic: Use massive outline numbers (e.g. '01', '02', '03' in JetBrains Mono, text-8xl, text-white/5) sitting behind the content.
global_staffing_module.content: Headline: 'Every Client. Every Candidate. Every City.' Emphasize the 'Human + Machine' partnership. Break into two distinct visual blocks (Machine = stark, code-like; Human = smooth, elegant typography).

demo_form.layout: py-32 flex flex-col items-center. Form container max-w-lg w-full.
demo_form.style: Premium Glassmorphism or solid #111622 container. Inputs must use bg-[#0B0F19] with border-white/10. Focus state MUST highlight border in Electric Blue. 'Begin Your Ascent' submit button.
demo_form.testing: All inputs and submit button must have data-testid attributes.

footer.content: Minimalist copyright, coordinate numbers (e.g., 27.9881° N, 86.9250° E for Mount Everest) in JetBrains Mono.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST use raw React JS (.jsx/.js), NOT TypeScript (.tsx) for components.
Do not apply generic `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`.
Do not center-align paragraphs; left-align body text for better reading flow. Headings can be centered if the layout demands it (e.g., Hero).
Never use purely transparent backgrounds on elements that float over content (e.g., navbars). Always apply a backdrop blur and a semi-transparent color (bg-[#0B0F19]/80).
Add 'aria-hidden="true"' to decorative 3D canvases and SVGs.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').
Ensure contrast ratio is accessible. The primary text color should be pure white (#FFF) on the #0B0F19 background.

If implementing the Three.js fluid blob is too complex with raw shaders, implement a simplified particle system using R3F <Points> and a useFrame hook that moves particles based on Math.sin/cos and mouse coordinates.

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Initialize Tailwind config with the brand colors and typography. Set up Lenis smooth scrolling in the main App wrapper.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Build the foundational layout (Header, Footer) and the global noise overlay texture.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Build the Framer Motion staggered line reveal component for the Kinetic Hero.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Implement the R3F WebGL Blob Canvas. Ensure it is absolutely positioned behind or beside the hero text. Handle mouse hover attraction and click explosion logic in useFrame.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Construct the Three Pillars Bento grid with precise hover states using Tailwind arbitrary values for shadows.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_6: Construct the Global Staffing module using large typography and asymmetric layout.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_7: Build the Contact Form using Shadcn form primitives (if available) or raw accessible HTML forms styled with Tailwind, ensuring data-testid exists.
